title: decaloba obtusa
intro: Decaloba obtusa, commonly known as "Pride of Bolivia" or "Golden Shower", is a flowering plant in the family Malpighiaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues.
